## Ctx.callbackPayload() method

Route handler for callback queries with payloads matching `intentCallback`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
callbackPayload?(): Promise<any>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;any&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by callback data with payloads.

## Example

callbackData = "start:123"

